functions.name: CancelPendingStreamingRequest
functions.docs: Tries to cancel a pending LOD change request. Requests cannot be canceled if they are in the finalization phase.

functions.name: HasPendingInitOrStreaming
functions.docs: Whether a stream in / out request is pending. Only one request can exists at anytime for a streamable asset. This also includes the resource initialization!

functions.name: RegisterMipLevelChangeCallback
functions.signature: RegisterMipLevelChangeCallback(Target, Component, LOD Idx, Timeout Secs, On Stream In, Callback)

functions.name: RegisterMipLevelChangeCallback
functions.signature: RegisterMipLevelChangeCallback(Target, Component, Timeout Start Secs, Callback Streaming Start, Timeout Done Secs, Callback Streaming Done)

functions.name: RemoveMipLevelChangeCallback
functions.docs:
Remove mip level change callbacks registered by a component.
@param Component The context component

functions.name: RemoveAllMipLevelChangeCallbacks
functions.docs: Not thread safe and must be called on GT timeline but not necessarily on GT (e.g. ParallelFor called from GT).

functions.name: TickMipLevelChangeCallbacks
functions.docs:
Invoke registered mip level change callbacks.
@param DeferredTickCBAssets Non-null if not called on GT. An array that collects assets with CBs that need to be called later on GT

functions.name: SetForceMipLevelsToBeResident
functions.signature: SetForceMipLevelsToBeResident(Target, Seconds, Cinematic LOD Group Mask)

functions.name: LinkStreaming
functions.docs: Links texture to the texture streaming manager.

functions.name: UnlinkStreaming
functions.docs: Unlinks texture from the texture streaming manager.

functions.name: IsFullyStreamedIn
functions.docs: Whether all miplevels of this texture have been fully streamed in, LOD settings permitting. Note that if optional mips are not mounted it will always return false.

functions.name: WaitForPendingInitOrStreaming
functions.signature: WaitForPendingInitOrStreaming(Target, Wait For LOD Transition, Send Completion Events)
functions.docs: Wait for any pending operation (like InitResource and Streaming) to complete.

functions.name: WaitForStreaming
functions.signature: WaitForStreaming(Target, Wait For LOD Transition, Send Completion Events)
functions.docs: Wait for any pending operation and make sure that the asset streamer has performed requested ops on this asset.
